analysis.source_style: photorealistic design animation with staged cabinet assembly and function demonstrations

motion_manifest.movement: show the original outward drawer motion
motion_manifest.open_state: the original storage contents are visible
motion_manifest.framing: low three-quarter close-up including the drawer front, timber top and fixed base surround
motion_manifest.visible_detail: show the full drawer opening and the folded garments inside, not a narrow dark slit
motion_manifest.stationary: the base carcass, timber top, room corner and floor
motion_manifest.avoid: a desk drawer, an empty white box, a different number or arrangement of drawers

motion_manifest.movement: swing the upper doors sideways as shown, preserving their hinge sides
motion_manifest.open_state: the timber-lined compartments and bedding are visible
motion_manifest.framing: front-facing close-up with all original upper door divisions visible
motion_manifest.visible_detail: reveal the timber-lined bedding compartments behind the sideways-opening fronts
motion_manifest.stationary: the top cabinet carcass and dividers
motion_manifest.avoid: upward lift-up flaps, a changed compartment grid or invented gas struts

motion_manifest.position: between the base and overhead storage
motion_manifest.closed_state: Preserve the original staged assembly view
motion_manifest.movement: reproduce the source's assembly/reveal order and then the sideways door opening
motion_manifest.open_state: matching hanging compartments and lower storage appear
motion_manifest.framing: medium frontal view connecting the upper storage, main wardrobe and base in one installation
motion_manifest.visible_detail: preserve the reference's hanging bays, the two vertically arranged hanging levels where visible, and the lower belongings
motion_manifest.stationary: the source cabinet width, divisions, timber interior and base position
motion_manifest.avoid: a new central tower of shelves, extra wardrobe bays or generic luxury closet layout

motion_manifest.position: at the wardrobe end beside the room door
motion_manifest.closed_state: The tall exterior panel is closed
motion_manifest.movement: move the same tall panel through the source opening path, keeping its attachment point fixed
motion_manifest.open_state: the coat-and-bag storage and side shelves are revealed
motion_manifest.framing: three-quarter end view including the wardrobe end and adjacent room door
motion_manifest.visible_detail: show the moving tall panel opening to expose the timber backing, coat hooks, hanging bag and side shelves in their original positions
motion_manifest.stationary: the surrounding end cabinet and adjacent room door
motion_manifest.avoid: static decorative shelving or a conventional clothes cupboard in place of the moving panel

motion_manifest.closed_state: The small lower door is closed
motion_manifest.movement: swing the small door open sideways
motion_manifest.open_state: the safe is visible inside the same compartment
motion_manifest.framing: closer low view of the small door beneath the side coat-and-bag area
motion_manifest.visible_detail: the door opens to reveal the dark safe inside the separate lower compartment
motion_manifest.stationary: the safe and the compartment carcass
motion_manifest.avoid: moving the safe to the bedside area, adding a safe drawer or enlarging the door

motion_manifest.position: at the original bed-side position on the wardrobe wall
motion_manifest.closed_state: Preserve the source's flush closed appearance
motion_manifest.movement: reproduce the visible shelf reveal without adding exposed hardware
motion_manifest.open_state: a compact timber-coloured shelf holds the source accessories
motion_manifest.framing: side close-up including the wall plane, timber-coloured shelf and bed edge when visible
motion_manifest.visible_detail: keep the shelf shallow and compact; reveal its top surface and the source's small objects
motion_manifest.stationary: the shelf's original height, attachment location and surrounding panel seams
motion_manifest.avoid: a large white flap, exposed oversized brackets, a deep timber-lined niche or a safe below this shelf

motion_manifest.position: beside the bed and wardrobe end
motion_manifest.movement: match the original final camera reveal
motion_manifest.open_state: the shelf, bed, side storage and mirror relationship remain as referenced
motion_manifest.visible_detail: retain the original bed, shelf, mirror and end-panel relationship, with readable surface detail and restrained daylight
motion_manifest.stationary: all completed cabinet divisions and accessory positions
motion_manifest.avoid: new pendant lights, a redesigned headboard, extra niches, unrelated decor or a second wardrobe
